C1807.title: Unitree Go1 Robot Dog CloudSail Pre-installed Backdoor (CVE-2025-2894)
C1807.summary: In March 2025, researchers disclosed an undocumented backdoor (CVE-2025-2894) in the Unitree Go1 consumer quadruped. The Oray CloudSail remote-access service auto-started on the onboard Raspberry Pi, establishing a P2P tunnel bypassing NAT; anyone with the default API key could fully remote-control the robot and access its camera. The CloudSail API showed 1919 devices online (including MIT, Princeton labs). Unitree silently patched on March 23 and revoked API tokens; the flaw is CWE-912 hidden functionality.
